steps.stepDescription: Open a web browser and navigate to https://kargone-admin.appening.xyz/auth/login
Locate the 'Add vehicle' button on the page and click it
Enter a 10-digit random number in the VIN number field
Enter a 5-digit random number in the zip code field
Select the second option for each question in the questionnaire
Click the submit button for the questionnaire
Wait for the dialog to appear after questionnaire submission
In the dialog, enter 'Geman Made' in the make field, 'knight edition' in the model field, and '2020' in the year field
Enter a 17-digit random number in the VIN number field within the dialog
Click the 'verify' button in the dialog to validate the vehicle details
Click the 'verify' button on the main form to list the car for selling
Take a screenshot of the completed vehicle listing to confirm success
